rooms.name: Floor Lobby / Reception
rooms.notes: Central core lobby serving lift and stair landings; curved to match circular floor plate.

rooms.name: Reception / Welcome Desk
rooms.notes: Open-plan reception facing lift lobby; full-glass curtain-wall gives panoramic city views.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office Zone A
rooms.notes: Primary open-plan workspace; perimeter band along glass curtain-wall for natural light; CPWD DSR 4.5 sqm/person yields ~26 persons.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office Zone B
rooms.notes: Secondary open-plan zone on opposite arc; mirrors Zone A for balanced occupancy distribution.

rooms.name: Meeting Room – Large (10-pax)
rooms.notes: Boardroom-style; glazed partition to office; acoustic treatment specified.

rooms.name: Meeting Room – Small (6-pax)
rooms.notes: Informal collaboration room; writeable walls; natural light via curtain-wall.

rooms.name: Focus / Study Pods
rooms.notes: Quiet focus area subdivided into 3 individual pods; acoustic glazing panels.

rooms.name: Pantry / Kitchenette
rooms.notes: Centrally located pantry; MEP wet riser connection; sustainability brief requires water-efficient fittings.

rooms.name: Male Toilet Block
rooms.notes: 3 WC + 2 urinals + 2 wash basins; NBC Part 9 Section 2 occupant-load ratios; IGBC water fixtures.

rooms.name: Female Toilet Block
rooms.notes: 4 WC + 2 wash basins; adjacency to service corridor; IGBC water fixtures.

rooms.name: Accessible / Gender-Neutral Toilet
rooms.notes: NBC Part 3 Sec 4 barrier-free provisions; 1800 mm turning circle; grab bars.

rooms.name: Service / Circulation Corridor
rooms.notes: Curved arc corridor along inner core ring; min 1.8 m clear width per NBC egress norms; fire-rated walls.

rooms.name: Services / Utilities Store
rooms.notes: MEP maintenance store and janitorial room; locked access.

rooms.name: Perimeter Terrace / Balcony
rooms.notes: Curved external terrace wrapping arc of circular floor plate; steel-frame cantilevered slab; rainwater harvesting channels integrated in parapet; biophilic planting troughs.

response.floor_summary: Floor 3 is a full office workspace floor accommodating open-plan zones, collaborative meeting rooms, focus pods, a central pantry, and a curved perimeter balcony with biophilic landscaping, all served by a circular core lobby and reception within the 30 m-diameter curtain-wall tower.
